metadata.name: GINS complex
metadata.description: DNA replication complex GINS participates in the initiation and elongation stages of replication. The name GINS is an acronym created from the first letters of the Japanese numbers 5-1-2-3 (go-ichi-ni-san) in a reference to the 4 protein subunits of the complex: SLD5, PSF1, PSF2, and PSF3
